_note: Scenarios are anchored to REAL weather found in weather/weather_hourly_raw.csv. 'expected_behaviour' is what the finished app should show; 'facts' are computed from the data.

scenarios.title: Scab at petal fall, scanned offline, carbendazim used 10 days ago
scenarios.photo_note: Any public apple-scab leaf (PlantDoc 'Apple Scab Leaf' CC-BY-4.0 or PlantVillage).

facts.last_spray: Carbendazim (Bavistin), FRAC 1, 10 days before the clock

expected_behaviour: Offline: on-device result + cached basic advice card for scab
Online: recommend a petal-fall scab product that is NOT FRAC 1 (e.g. myclobutanil 80 g/200 L, waiting period 21 days)
Show waiting period vs days to harvest; spray-timing advice from the next-12h rain figure above

scenarios.title: Marssonina blotch weather in July: the on-device model has no Marssonina class, so the server apple model is needed
scenarios.photo_note: NO openly downloadable Marssonina photo set exists (Khan et al. 2020 not public). Ask the client for Marssonina photos; until then demo with a model-card example.
expected_behaviour: On-device model cannot name Marssonina (no such class): expect a wrong class or low confidence -> 'not sure, checking online'
Server model (untested on field photos): if it returns Marssonina -> advice from Nauni July 2026 advisory (metiram 600 g/200 L protectant)
Weather-risk badge 'Marssonina/Alternaria weather' is red

scenarios.title: Heavy rain right after a mancozeb spray -> automatic 're-spray within 7 days' alert
expected_behaviour: Push alert at the clock time: heavy rain within 12 h of spraying -> repeat the spray within 7 days (HP 2026 rule)
Mark the spray as 'washed off' in the diary and write the note back to Zoho

scenarios.title: Scab infection period reached the Mills threshold -> automatic alert to every apple farmer in the Jubbal block
expected_behaviour: Alert fires at the moment cumulative leaf-wetness hours reach the Mills requirement
Each farmer's message names their own last spray and avoids repeating its chemical group

scenarios.title: Off-label products found in the farmer's Zoho history (copied from the client's real rows)

flagged: Syngenta Miravis Duo (not approved for apple: tomato, chilli, groundnut, grape)
Meothrin / fenpropathrin 30% EC (no apple label claim)
Trot / thiamethoxam 30% FS (seed treatment, not a foliar spray)

expected_behaviour: Admin 'data quality' view flags the three rows as off-label for apple
The recommendation engine never proposes them; farmer sees a gentle warning

scenarios.title: Micronutrients logged the same day as a fungicide (the client's own 14/04/2026 pattern)

facts.hp2026_rule: HP 2026 point 7: do not mix any other pesticide/chemical/micro-nutrient/growth regulator/hormone with the recommended pesticides (russeting and other disorders); spray separately when necessary

expected_behaviour: Diary shows an amber note: 'Zinc/Boron and 12-61-00 were logged with a fungicide the same day. HP 2026 says to spray micronutrients separately, not mixed with the recommended pesticides.' (the data cannot tell a tank-mix from separate sprays)

scenarios.title: Four DMI (FRAC 3) sprays already used -> next recommendation must avoid DMI

facts.frac_limit: DMI <= 4 per season, alone or in mixture (FRAC pome-fruit guidance)

expected_behaviour: Engine excludes every product containing FRAC 3 (incl. mixtures)
Offers non-DMI options such as propineb / metiram, or metiram + pyraclostrobin (QoI count still 0)

scenarios.title: Potato late-blight weather (NIPHM 7-day rule) turns true -> automatic alert and advice
scenarios.photo_note: PlantVillage / PlantDoc potato late blight image.
expected_behaviour: Alert: late blight expected within 10 days
Advice: mancozeb 2 kg/ha in 1000 L as protectant (every ~10 days); cymoxanil + mancozeb 3 kg/ha only if symptoms are already visible

scenarios.title: Tomato yellow leaf curl virus: no cure, only vector control + roguing
expected_behaviour: Card says 'no cure' in plain words; NO fungicide is offered
Shows whitefly control (imidacloprid 150-175 ml/ha, waiting period 3 d) and roguing, yellow traps (10 per acre), net nursery

scenarios.title: Stale Zoho record (last update > 60 days) -> advice asks the farmer to confirm recent sprays
expected_behaviour: Before recommending, the app asks 'Did you spray after 5 Aug?' (checkbox) so rotation and waiting-period logic uses current data

scenarios.title: Sensor station offline: 'My field' shows a stale-data warning, alerts are marked 'based on forecast only'
expected_behaviour: Last reading is >48 h old -> amber 'sensor offline since 10 Jul' banner
Automatic alerts fall back to the weather-API forecast and say so
